name: Hesperian-Crucible
description: A battered sphere of bare stone, cratered so densely that old impacts overlap like raindrops on a pond. Through it all runs solar wind erosion patterns, stark under a black sky.
Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound.
Debris from the escape pod debris field rings the crash basin in a perfect fan, which ballistics cannot explain. Survivors' accounts disagree about the last hour completely.
Whoever controls silicon controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
